specification.title: Agent CloudDrive 一期工程交接报告

source_verification.note: R4当前源码聚合检查通过，包含新example；真实native演示通过，未运行Docker/browser等仍明确不晋级。
source_verification.tree_hash_scope: scripts/release-readiness.py SOURCE_PATHS, excluding caches and build outputs

native_core.scope: Actual Keycloak/oCIS/PostgreSQL/NATS/Meilisearch application loop, local artifact store and direct UTF-8 text; no identity/original/message/search mocks.

native_identity.scope: Actual PKCE, consent, token exchange and offline refresh observations; documented limitations remain.

native_ocis.scope: Actual local and s3ng small-file protocol probes, historical reads and MOVE; proves native precondition counterexamples, not final tus CAS or multipart.

ocis_adapter.scope: Actual oCIS Go adapter create/resume, fixed ETag-gated reads, Range, MOVE/restore with history.

native_artifact_search.scope: Actual S3 and Meilisearch component operations; not the complete S3 application loop.

postgres_app.scope: Real PostgreSQL and race detector; identity/original-store contract fixtures are not native identity/oCIS acceptance.

worker_native.scope: Real PostgreSQL/NATS/Meilisearch/local artifacts; identity and original-store fixtures remain explicit contracts.

sql_invariants.scope: Actual PostgreSQL invariants, not service/browser behavior.

share_races.scope: Actual DB approval/delete/account-disable serialization; identity/native content fixtures.

feedback.scope: Actual DB no principal activity write/outbox correlation; does not inspect deployed gateway/APM logs.

mcp_contract.scope: Official MCP SDK/HTTP protocol and real PostgreSQL; not the Peri application or real browser identity flow.

source_selftest.scope: Executed Go race/vet, sqlc drift, real DB invariants, frontend build/tests, converters and deployment generation; explicit native/browser skips.

conversion_matrix.scope: Actual sample-format and local CPU OCR report; 200-page injected failure accounting is not full real OCR acceptance; external vision unavailable.

browser_blocker.scope: Chromium launch failed before page creation; no browser smoke screenshot or 10 GiB upload accepted.

runtime_blocker.scope: Native dependencies started without Docker/Podman; no complete Compose runtime acceptance.

deployment_config.scope: Configuration and operator instructions only; not evidence that containers ran.

target_race_initial.scope: Initial failing target-path race reproduction, retained as historical evidence and superseded by security_review_fixed.

security_review_fixed.scope: Ten focused security regressions repeated three times with real PostgreSQL and race detector; native identity/original calls remain labeled contracts. Includes target-path race, stale parent reload, cancellation cleanup, retained audit and share isolation.

native_application_expanded.scope: Actual two-user HTTP application, Keycloak, oCIS, PostgreSQL, NATS and Meilisearch: exclusive overwrite admission, fixed history, trash/restore, private isolation, scoped denial, confirmed REST sharing and MCP received-share exclusion. Does not prove every entry point or Peri/browser use.

native_conversion.scope: 35 actual converter tests, including native AnyDoc, PaddleOCR CPU HTTP/scanned-PDF recovery, and patched kkFileView DOCX/XLSX/PPTX to PDF to PNG. No real external vision or 200-page OCR throughput acceptance.

native_deployment_setup.scope: Five setup/configuration tests, including actual signed RustFS bucket creation twice. Standalone Compose configuration validation is not Docker Engine or Compose startup.

preview_build_provenance.scope: Pinned official-source kkFileView project build, explicit spreadsheet PDF patch, native test scope, upstream Maven tests skipped, no Docker runtime or vision provider.

native_portable_final.scope: Frozen-source shipped HTTP probe against actual Keycloak/oCIS/PostgreSQL/NATS/Meilisearch: exact-file core loop, concurrent admission denial, stale second reader after first commit rejected, same idempotency key returns same upload ID, duplicate finalization returns same source version, retained originals/trash/restore, two-user isolation and actual MCP 2026-07-28. Not Peri, browser, full S3 or 10 GiB.

native_joint_candidate.scope: Actual native real Keycloak/oCIS/PostgreSQL application API: five new scenarios, 178 assertions. Ten retained versions/quota, subtree lifecycle, restore collision/share reconfirmation, 100-item batch replay, all39 unauthenticated bearer routes plus Range. Not browser, audit grants, search-path convergence, Compose, or10GiB.

native_joint_provenance.scope: Native binary identities, dependency fixture versions and explicitly post-run source/result snapshot hashes for the new actual API run; no atomic launch-time script attestation, browser, Compose or10GiB assertion.

native_joint_final.scope: Frozen rebuilt candidate actual Keycloak/oCIS/PG/NATS/Meili five joint scenarios and186assertions, including raw search source_path convergence; not browser/Compose/10GiB.

native_joint_final_provenance.scope: Prelaunch hashes of tested source tree, drivers and actual application binaries, verified unchanged after actual native run.

maintenance_regression.scope: Real PostgreSQL+raced maintenance fairness/backlog/large-subtree batching, explicit identity/search/NATS contract implementations.

acceptance_driver_checks.scope: 100Python+37Node offline driver guards/syntax/source contracts; no browser or10GiB execution.

candidate_source_selftest.scope: Frozen second delivery complete source race/vet/sqlc/realPG/NATS/Meili/frontend/converter realOCR+Office/deployment realRustFS/driver guard suite; explicit browser/Compose/Peri/10GiB skips.

r3_source_aggregate.scope: R3 frozen production aggregate: Go race/vet/sqlc/PG/NATS/Meili/RustFS/frontend50/build/converters34 passed plus1 explicit kkFileView skip/deployment5. Not full acceptance.

r3_source_binding.scope: Aggregate and final v6 source delta/manifests bind unchanged production and separately rechecked integration drivers; all historical failures/skips remain explicit.

r3_driver_final.scope: 221 Python and37 Node offline guards, no source drift. Preparation only; not deployed/browser acceptance.

r3_deterministic_regressions.scope: 48 repeated leaf scenarios under race detector and real PostgreSQL: stale index ordering/delete-restore, batch limits/failure recovery, fencing, pool-one, security persistence and allocation/page-provenance bounds. Search/identity/native contracts explicitly controlled.

r3_joint_final.scope: Actual R3 Keycloak/oCIS/PG/NATS/Meili five joint scenarios and186 assertions, local artifacts/direct UTF-8; not browser/Compose/10GiB.

r3_stress_combined.scope: Actual1/4/8/16/32/64 concurrency ten-workload native pressure,9725HTTP/654expected409/0unexpected,420files426versions; global RSS and queues only,1KiB synthetic text,not capacity ceiling.

r3_fault_final.scope: Four actual recoverable scenarios77checks: owned worker/NATS/Meili graceful interruption and actual lost finalize response. Selected pass, full partial; native MOVE loss not run.

r3_combined_provenance.scope: Combined295.725seconds, actual binary hashes, unchanged start/end source, baseline resource/drain and graceful cleanup; deliberately partial due unsupported native MOVE loss.

r3_stress_report.scope: Bounded pressure/fault interpretation, preserved failures, deterministic defect fixes and strict remaining exclusions.

r3_stress_resources_final.scope: Final source-bound native1/4/8/16/32/64 pressure:11266HTTP/726expected409/0unexpected,492files498versions; per-stage sampled RSS/queues with raw timestamp windows.1KiB small-text and local artifact mode,not production capacity.

r3_stress_resources_provenance.scope: Final source909c46e unchanged before/after, actual binary hashes,266.840second supervisor budget and graceful child cleanup; stress-only,not full fault gate.

r3_independent_review.scope: Independent review of six defect classes, real-PG/race48scenario checks, offline174driver guards, combined native186/77checks and final six-stage resources; explicit unexecuted limits remain.

r4_source_aggregate.scope: Current frozen R4 source aggregate: real PG/NATS/Meili Go race/vet, sqlc/SQL, frontend, Python/example and offline driver checks. Explicit native/OCR/Office/browser skips remain.

r4_native_example.scope: Actual native R4 preflight/seed/check/metadata edit and application-process restart preserving user edits and historical bytes; local storage, test HTTP proxy, not Docker Engine/browser.

r4_example_review.scope: Independent example safety review and checked live scoped evidence; not full deployment acceptance.

r4_verification.scope: Explicit R4 execution provenance, retained failures, full aggregate skips, and Docker/browser limits.

r4_compose_config.scope: Actual standalone Compose configuration parsing only, no Docker engine.

r4_source_binding.scope: Final R4 source digest bound to current passing aggregate and frozen native example script hashes.

gates.title: 官方 oCIS 用户、空间、后端凭据与 Keycloak
gates.requirement: 业务主体映射稳定；后台可合法读取授权源版本；停用可被执行
gates.verified_scope: 真实主体/个人空间、PKCE、离线委托读取与核心闭环通过；两名真实 IdP 测试用户的原件/搜索隔离也已验证。
remaining: 仍需真实账号停用/重新启用的完整访问与分享传播证据。

gates.title: Peri + MCP OAuth
gates.requirement: 授权发现、PKCE、audience、scope、刷新/重授权、Streamable HTTP 真实可用
gates.verified_scope: 实际 HTTP MCP 2026-07-28 discovery/list/call 与独立 2025-11-25 初始化通过；实际 Keycloak PKCE 通过。它们不是 Peri 客户端联调。
remaining: 缺少真实 Peri 客户端；未执行 Peri 授权发现、刷新/重授权与 Streamable HTTP 联调。

gates.title: tus 覆盖与最终条件提交
gates.requirement: 冲突写入无法覆盖先提交版本；重试不重复生成版本
gates.verified_scope: 真实应用/oCIS 在上传期间排他拒绝竞争者；首个提交后旧期望版本再次请求返回 VERSION_CONFLICT，当前字节和历史不变；重复同键返回同一上传 ID，重复 finalize 返回同一源版本。目标路径竞争修复有 DB race 回归。依赖业务门禁，不宣称原生 tus 自带最终 CAS。

gates.title: 原生版本固定读取
gates.requirement: 旧任务在新版本上传后仍读取原来的字节；重命名不改变引用
gates.verified_scope: 原生覆盖后旧 ETag/版本映射仍读取原字节；重命名/MOVE 后固定引用可读。

gates.title: MOVE 业务回收站
gates.requirement: 移入/移出保留目录后资源身份、所有原生版本与审核读取保留
gates.verified_scope: 真实单文件原生保留目录 MOVE/移回和应用删除/恢复均通过，资源身份、当前内容及生成的历史修订保持。

gates.title: RustFS 与 oCIS S3
gates.requirement: 基本 CRUD、Range、multipart、原生修订读写兼容
gates.verified_scope: RustFS/S3 产物 CRUD、Range、不可变发布，以及 oCIS s3ng 小文件修订/MOVE 通过。
remaining: 小样本没有执行 multipart；10 GiB 默认 S3 与完整应用 S3 闭环未完成。

gates.title: AnyDoc/PDF/OCR/图片资产
gates.requirement: 样本格式矩阵与页码映射清晰；部分失败可被真实表示
gates.verified_scope: 真实 AnyDoc 样本、PDF 提取/渲染、CPU OCR、扫描 PDF 恢复、持久图片与缺页报告通过；私有 kkFileView 三种 Office 样本输出 PNG 通过。
remaining: 真实外部视觉模型未配置；200 页真实 OCR 五页失败的完整读取/检索场景未执行；未测格式不扩大宣称。

gates.title: 原生配额与清理
gates.requirement: 业务配额允许的写入可完成；无后台任务清除审核历史
gates.verified_scope: 业务配额和保留约束有数据库测试；原生自动清理禁用按配置落实。
remaining: 仍需在真实部署证明原生配额不先行拒绝业务允许的覆盖/历史保留，及运行清理配置核验。

gates.title: 受控预览
gates.requirement: 匿名链接不能获得原件下载接口；撤销、换版后资源请求失效
gates.verified_scope: 分享实时门禁、固定/当前版本访问已有回归；实际 kkFileView DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 经明确 PDF 补丁转换为 PNG，PDF/SVG 安全栅格化通过。
remaining: 实际匿名完整资源请求链、撤销/换版后所有预览资源即时失效仍需端到端证据。

gates.title: 匿名链路
gates.requirement: DB、网关、应用、MCP、APM 与消息中无法关联提交身份
gates.verified_scope: 匿名反馈不写主体活动/关联 outbox，MCP 专用无来源路径已有回归。
remaining: 尚未运行完整网关/应用/MCP/APM/消息部署并全面检查持久日志与来源关联。

gates.title: 用户 A 上传私有文件，用户 B 搜索/猜测 ID
gates.requirement: B 无正文、摘要、路径、图片、下载或计数泄露
gates.verified_scope: 实际两个 Keycloak 用户中，B stat/下载 A 私有文件均 404，搜索不返回该文件；域/SDK 权限过滤与无未授权计数有回归。
remaining: 仍需真实双用户覆盖正文片段、路径、图片、预览、下载和计数所有入口的完整隔离场景。

gates.title: Agent 获得部分 scopes
gates.requirement: 越权操作被拒绝；文件范围仍为整个自有个人空间
gates.verified_scope: 部分 scopes 的服务端拒绝和 Agent 自有空间限制通过域/官方 SDK 回归；实际 read-only token 创建目录返回 403。

gates.title: 用户收到他人只读分享
gates.requirement: 网页可按授权访问；Agent 搜索、读取与下载均拒绝
gates.verified_scope: 实际确认后接收者 REST 下载成功，同接收者 MCP 查询该文件被拒绝；固定历史分享与 Agent 自有空间限制有真实 DB/协议回归。
remaining: 实际网页接收者操作及 Agent 搜索/正文/下载全部入口的联合场景仍需记录；HTTP 协议探测不能称为 Peri 联调。

gates.title: 两 Agent 读同版后覆盖
gates.requirement: A 成功，B 冲突；A 内容和历史保留
gates.verified_scope: 使用共同原期望版本的两方请求，第二方在首个上传期间被拒；首个完成后第二方用旧期望版本再次写入仍 409。随后精确读回首个新正文和原历史正文。真实 HTTP/应用/oCIS 流程，不冒充 Peri 客户端。

gates.title: 相同幂等请求重复发送
gates.requirement: 返回同一操作/版本，不重复扣配额或创建版本
gates.verified_scope: 真实应用/oCIS 的相同幂等请求返回同一上传 ID，重复 finalize 返回同一源版本；实际数据库并发与配额测试证明不重复预留/计费，异体同键冲突。

gates.title: 新版转换未完成
gates.requirement: 所有者检索旧内容，明确旧版本和新版处理状态
gates.verified_scope: 当前源版本与已发布搜索代次分离、版本优先级和真实索引发布分别通过。
remaining: 需记录真实应用新版处理中检索旧内容的响应，含返回旧版本和新版状态。

gates.title: 最新版分享遇到新版处理中
gates.requirement: 可预览当前原件；无权读取旧版转换或旧原件
gates.verified_scope: 最新版分享拒绝旧版原件/旧产物，固定历史授权不会被替换成当前版本。
remaining: 需要实际匿名/内部预览在新版处理中只访问当前原件的端到端记录。

gates.title: 200 页样本有 5 页 OCR 失败
gates.requirement: 成功页可读可搜，精确列出 5 页及不完整状态
gates.verified_scope: 200 页真实 PDF 的五页缺失映射测试通过；小型扫描件真实 CPU OCR 通过。
remaining: 五页故障注入不能替代 200 页实际 OCR 后成功页读取、搜索和精确五页失败的完整验收。

gates.title: 仅视觉描述失败
gates.requirement: 文本成功可用；描述缺失明确，不能标完整
gates.verified_scope: 文本提取成功、视觉服务缺失时返回 partial，并明确缺失描述，不伪报完整。
remaining: 真实配置的视觉服务失败/恢复场景及描述语义质量尚未验收。

gates.title: 超过自动转换上限
gates.requirement: 原件成功保存，显示未转换；调参后可重试
gates.verified_scope: 超过限制仍保留原件且 worker 标记未转换的真实 DB 测试通过。
remaining: 需记录真实应用修改配置后手动重试成功的完整场景。

gates.title: 转换器升级、手动重转旧文件
gates.requirement: 新代次发布；旧引用仍返回旧源版本/旧代次
gates.verified_scope: 不可变源版本/产物、多代次优先级与旧原件固定读通过。
remaining: 需实际升级配方、手动重转并同时读取旧引用和新代次的联合证据。

gates.title: 旧 Worker 或索引任务晚到
gates.requirement: 不能覆盖较新代次；消息重投不重复发布
gates.verified_scope: 过期 lease/fencing token、旧版本/旧代次发布被数据库拒绝；真实 JetStream/Meilisearch 异步完成与持久消费回归通过。

gates.title: 删除已分享文件
gates.requirement: 立即隐藏并停用分享；原生 MOVE 后历史可审核
gates.verified_scope: 数据库删除立即失效分享与祖先门禁通过，真实原生 MOVE 保留历史独立通过。
remaining: 真实已分享文件从应用删除到受控历史审核读取的联合场景待记录。

gates.title: 恢复目标同名
gates.requirement: 返回路径冲突；指定新目标后恢复；分享不自动恢复
gates.verified_scope: 真实 Keycloak 双用户与应用/oCIS 联合通过：同名占位恢复409且占位原件不变；改名恢复保留ID/历史/配额；旧分享仍拒绝当前/历史/Range读取，新CSRF确认后才可访问。

gates.title: 删除/移动整个目录
gates.requirement: 子项门禁正确，ID 与历史不变，路径标签更新
gates.verified_scope: 真实两层子树MOVE、删除、恢复55项断言通过：ID/父子关系/两个文件各两版字节保留，删除时当前入口和公开搜索立即拒绝；真实Meilisearch原始source_path在MOVE/恢复后收敛，version/artifact均不变。修复维护积压及>100子树分块并通过PG/race回归。

gates.title: 十个版本后删除
gates.requirement: 配额仅计最新大小；删除后额度不变
gates.verified_scope: 真实应用/oCIS依次上传十个不同源版本，每次配额仅计最新大小；十个版本在删除前、回收期间及恢复后逐字节读取一致；删除额度不变、恢复不重复收费。

gates.title: 100 项批处理有一项冲突
gates.requirement: 独立项继续，逐项结果清晰，重试不重复成功项
gates.verified_scope: 真实应用/oCIS执行100个独立目录创建项，99成功1个PATH_CONFLICT；同批次和新批次相同逐项键重试复用99个操作/文件ID，最终恰好100个目录含原占位项。

gates.title: Agent 请求分享
gates.requirement: 用户确认前不可访问；Agent 不能调用批准接口
gates.verified_scope: Agent 无批准工具/能力，确认哈希不可变；实际 REST 批准缺少交互 CSRF 返回 403，正确会话+CSRF 批准后接收者可下载。
remaining: 实际 Agent 发起请求到网页人工确认前后访问状态的完整链路仍需记录。

gates.title: 账号停用再启用
gates.requirement: 所有访问与分享停用；启用后分享仍需确认
gates.verified_scope: 真实 DB 停用/启用不恢复分享、维护同步、公开请求观察停用的回归通过。
remaining: 真实 IdP 停用并重新启用用户后所有访问与分享的联合场景待验证。

gates.title: 撤销组成员或公开分享
gates.requirement: 后续预览、图片、Range/下载请求无法绕过
gates.verified_scope: 实时组成员/分享状态/源版本检查的代码与组件拒绝测试存在。
remaining: 真实组撤销及公开撤销后图片、预览、Range 和下载各入口联合验证未完成。

gates.title: 匿名链接预览 PDF/Office/SVG
gates.requirement: 不下发原件下载地址；SVG 无主动脚本执行
gates.verified_scope: PDF/SVG 安全栅格化通过；实际私有 kkFileView DOCX/XLSX/PPTX → PDF → PNG 输出、临时源清理通过。原生 Office 使用明确的 PDF-only 源码补丁。
remaining: 真实匿名浏览器完整请求链、没有原件或内部 URL 泄露、撤销后资源拒绝仍需验证。

gates.title: 提交反馈后检查持久数据与日志
gates.requirement: 无来源关联；反馈不出现在 Agent 读取与搜索
gates.verified_scope: 反馈独立表、无主体活动/outbox 来源记录、MCP 反馈回归通过。
remaining: 完整部署的网关/APM/消息日志扫描与 Agent 正文/搜索排除联合场景仍待验收。

gates.title: 远端操作成功但业务响应丢失
gates.requirement: 重试/对账得到原结果，不产生错误覆盖或重复版本
gates.verified_scope: 真实成功finalize响应被代理丢弃后同键重试保持原上传/文件/源版本，未重复配额或提交；本地worker/NATS/Meili停机恢复也通过。MOVE丢响应由真实数据库合同对账验证，不冒充native端到端。
remaining: 真实native MOVE成功但响应丢失的联合对账仍未执行；无原生ID的未知MKCOL保持门禁，不能盲目重试。
